core.title: Filter bar / faceted filters
covers: applied filters as removable chips with counts
core.guidance: Desktop: filter row above the content with chips for applied filters; facets as popovers with checkboxes and counts; 'clear all'; results update with a count. Mobile: filter button with badge count opens a sheet; apply button; applied chips under the search field. Persist in URL.
core.avoid_when: One or two filters (inline selects); TV (use rail categories or a simple filter row).

core.title: One-page checkout
covers: inline validation messages and error recovery
confirmation of destructive or high-risk actions
core.guidance: Order summary is visible on desktop (side column) and collapsible-but-present at the top on phones with the total always shown; guest checkout first, account optional; sections in the order contact → shipping → payment → review, each with a visible heading and inline validation on blur plus a focused error summary on submit; address fields use autocomplete attributes and correct input types/IME; the pay button states the amount, is disabled only while processing (with a visible status), and is protected against double submission; trust and cost information (shipping, tax) appears before payment, never as a surprise; progress is saved locally so a reload does not lose entries.
core.use_when: Purchase flows with contact, shipping, payment and review on one scrolling page.
core.avoid_when: Multi-session or regulated flows that need a stepper with server-side validation per step.

implementation.html-css: autocomplete="shipping postal-code" etc.; inputmode="numeric" for card and postal fields; aria-describedby error links; aria-live status on the pay button.

core.title: Utility commerce
core.guidance: Search and filters dominate the header, product tiles with price and the deciding fact, comparison-friendly metadata, sticky add-to-cart on PDP, brand colour on action and header only, humanist sans for long product names and multilingual catalogues. Identity via tile geometry, price typography, and the filter chip language.
core.use_when: Catalogue-heavy retail where finding, comparing, and buying fast matters (electronics, parts, groceries, B2B ordering).

guardrails.title: Everything operable by keyboard, no traps
guardrails.guidance: Tab reaches every control in visual order; composite widgets use arrow keys with a roving tabindex so Tab is not consumed by every cell; Escape closes layers and returns focus to the invoker; nothing traps focus except a modal, and the modal itself must be escapable. Provide a keyboard alternative for every drag interaction.
guardrails.use_when: Every interactive element, including custom widgets, drag/drop, sliders, menus, date pickers, and anything that appears on hover.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: accessibility, interaction, no hover dependence, keyboard navigation and focus order

guardrails.title: Search and filters: visible state and instant feedback
covers: applied filters as removable chips with counts
guardrails.guidance: Applied filters as removable chips with a 'clear all', result count announced, debounced query (≈300 ms) with a loading indicator, empty results suggest next steps, filter state in the URL/route, and on TV a search screen with a system keyboard/voice plus results as rails.
guardrails.use_when: Catalogues, tables, media libraries, admin lists.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never hide applied filters; never reset filters on navigation without asking; never search on every keystroke against a slow backend without debounce.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: search field and results behaviour

guardrails.title: Focus visible and not obscured
guardrails.guidance: Focus indicator ≥2 px with ≥3:1 contrast against adjacent colours and against the unfocused state; sticky UI gets scroll-padding so a focused control scrolls into clear view. On TV the indicator must be obvious at 3 m (scale + border/glow).
guardrails.use_when: Every focusable element in every theme; sticky headers, footers, toasts, and cookie banners must never cover the focused element.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never remove focus styles; use :focus-visible to hide them for mouse clicks only.

guardrails.title: Design empty, loading, error, and partial states
guardrails.guidance: Empty: what this is, why it is empty, one action. Loading: skeleton with final dimensions, then content; announce completion. Error: what failed, what to do, retry that works; keep entered data. Partial: show what loaded, mark what didn't. On TV, focus must land somewhere valid in each state.
guardrails.use_when: Every list, table, chart, form, and detail screen.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never ship a blank area for empty data; never show a spinner for more than ~1 s without a skeleton or progress; never show an error without a next step.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: loading, empty and error states
